blurb: YA Habit Tracker is a simple and effective tool to help you build and maintain positive habits.
description:
YA Habit Tracker is a simple and effective tool to help you build and maintain positive habits. It helps you track your progress and stay motivated.

Features:

* Create and customize habits
* Track your progress with a simple interface
* View your streaks
* Minimalist and user-friendly design
* No ads and completely free to use
